outcome: Conformity to national guidelines for prolonged pregnancy management
Neonatal morbidity (ventilation, resuscitation, Apgar score < 7 at 5 minutes)
Maternal morbidity (obstetrical anal sphincter injury, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 596 patients with a birth term of ≥ 41+0 weeks of gestation from 23 maternity hospitals in a perinatal network in France between September and December 2018.
finding: Management of prolonged and post-term pregnancies generally matched French national guidelines, with room for improvement in amniotic fluid evaluation and patient information regarding induction of labor.
